props.title: Creating good design demands honesty and respect
props.description:
Sparro Furniture is a family-owned company, established in 1982, leading within storage and furniture for private homes and contemporary office spaces. The company is founded by Peter J. Lassen, who is also the designer of the Sparro system.

All Sparro modules are designed, developed and made in Denmark. Every day, in a small town on the island of Funen over 140 professionals work hard to uphold the highest standards of processing, painting and assembling – making sure that your Sparro furniture will last a lifetime.

props.title: 41 water-based colours – a body-mind philosophy
props.description: Every eight years, Sparro develops a new colour palette. Our current palette was created in collaboration with colour expert Margrethe Odgaard. Read more about Margrethe's creative process towards a new and more sensual colour palette.
